episodes.title: Introduction to Navigating Digital Information
episodes.description: Introduce strategies for finding reliable information amid the Internet's misleading and false claims.

episodes.title: The Facts about Fact Checking
episodes.description: Check authorship, motives, and supporting evidence while distinguishing useful skepticism from cynicism.

episodes.title: Check Yourself with Lateral Reading
episodes.description: Open additional sources while reading to verify claims and understand unfamiliar websites.

episodes.title: Who Can You Trust?
episodes.description: Evaluate authority, expertise, credibility, and viewpoint when choosing online sources.

episodes.title: Using Wikipedia
episodes.description: Use Wikipedia for orientation, cross-checking, and locating reliable original sources while recognizing its limitations.

episodes.title: Evaluating Evidence
episodes.description: Distinguish strong supporting evidence from weak material or facts that do not establish a claim.

episodes.title: Evaluating Photos & Videos
episodes.description: Check visual media through context, outside sources, and verification rather than trusting appearances alone.

episodes.title: Data & Infographics
episodes.description: Critically assess numbers and graphics that can quickly inform people or mislead them.

episodes.title: Click Restraint
episodes.description: Resist impulsive clicks and examine search results before equating freshness or ranking with accuracy.

episodes.title: Social Media
episodes.description: Explore how social feeds operate and influence opinions, communities, purchasing, and behavior beyond the screen.
